item.racmc.pda.visual_hint: Original-disc PDA visuals; provisional Minecraft fitting. No substitute artwork.
screen.racmc.pda.title: Gadgetron PDA
screen.racmc.pda.ready: Select quantity, then request a server quote. The world stays live.
screen.racmc.pda.review: Review the quoted quantity and total. Confirm purchases; Cancel quote changes nothing.
screen.racmc.pda.wait: Waiting for server. Close cancels this session, not a purchase already committed.
screen.racmc.pda.uncertain: Receipt delayed. Wait or close; do not repurchase to resolve an uncertain result.
screen.racmc.pda.result.insufficient: Not enough bolts. No ammunition purchased.
screen.racmc.pda.result.stock_cap: Requested amount exceeds the 200-round cap. No purchase.
screen.racmc.pda.result.full: Not enough inventory room for the whole delivery. No charge or drops.
screen.racmc.pda.result.stale_offer: Blaster required, or inventory changed. Request a fresh quote.
screen.racmc.pda.result.stale_balance: Balance changed. Request a fresh quote.
screen.racmc.pda.result.stale_quote: Quote expired or was replaced. Request a fresh quote.
screen.racmc.pda.result.commit_rejected: Purchase rejected. No automatic retry; request a fresh quote.
screen.racmc.pda.result.stale_request: Request out of order. Close and reopen the PDA.
screen.racmc.pda.result.conflict: Request conflict. Close and reopen the PDA.
screen.racmc.pda.result.exhausted: Session request limit reached. Close and reopen the PDA.
item.racmc.clank_pack.creative_hint: Creative-only session setup: right-click to equip or switch. Cleared on death/logout.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.title: Select a Ratchet & Clank disc image
screen.racmc.iso_selection.path_hint: Path to the ISO file of your own disc
screen.racmc.iso_selection.hint: Only PAL v2.00 and NTSC-U v1.00 disc images are supported.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.mandatory: A verified disc image is needed before a world can be played.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.not_configure: No disc image is configured yet.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.status.no_pat: Enter the path of a disc image first.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.status.invali: The path is not a valid file system path.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.status.revali: The configured disc image is verified again.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.status.accept: The image is a verified %s disc.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.status.io_err: The disc image could not be read.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.assets.missin: The assets of the game are not in the cache yet.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.assets.buildi: The assets of the game are converted: %s%%
screen.racmc.iso_selection.assets.ready: The assets of the game are ready.
screen.racmc.iso_selection.assets.failed: The assets of the game could not be converted: %s
screen.racmc.blaster_test.title: Ratchet and his Blaster
screen.racmc.blaster_test.waiting: The assets of the game are not in the cache yet.
screen.racmc.blaster_test.failed: The assets of the game could not be drawn. The reason is in the log of the game.
screen.racmc.blaster_test.hint: The imported geometry, the imported textures and the imported animations of the hero and of his Blaster. The Blaster hangs on the joint of the hand of the hero and plays its own firing sequence.
